provenance.notes: Every profile is a synthetic question set. There are no country-specific price, income, grid, charging, legal, parts, service, performance, or lifecycle observations in this corpus.

profiles.rationale: Tests mobility choices where private home charging cannot be assumed; public/shared charging and non-car links need evidence.
Tests heat/dust qualification and repair/service reach without claiming a specific region has these properties.
Requires declared cold/high-altitude energy and performance envelopes before the configuration can be recommended.
Separates wet-weather, corrosion and flood capability claims; ordinary water resistance is not a flood-traversal qualification.
Requires platform-specific grade/braking/traction evidence and recovery access; terrain capability does not imply roadworthiness.
Tests total household mobility continuity and return-to-service, not just vehicle purchase cost.
Negative control for import-dependent critical parts with no confirmed local service/lead-time evidence.
Negative control: never infer charging or reliable electricity from an EV label or nominal grid connection.
Tests offline manual/diagnostic access, language coverage and safe degraded function without mandatory cloud access.
Negative control: disrupted energy, communications and parts supply must remain explicit; do not assume emergency resources are available.
Tests affordability against intended user segments and full cash-flow timing, not against one global sticker-price ceiling.
Requires local traffic/context and vulnerable-road-user considerations; a vehicle-only score cannot establish socially safe deployment.
Tests consent-based accessibility tasks, ingress/egress, controls, caregiver/cargo interface and service access rather than assuming a universal body or cabin.
